_about: Design tokens of the Android Mess Machine at build 170 (2026-11-23), copied from the code. Colours are ARGB hex as written in Kotlin (0xAARRGGBB). Sizes are dp (Android density-independent pixels; use pt on iOS, CSS px on the web) unless they say sp (text) or px. 'rdp' means real dp: divide by the view size so the size on the glass stays the same (see sizing.rdp). Sources: ui/Widgets.kt, ui/Icons.kt, ui/BarPlan.kt, ui/App.kt, ui/PadsScreen.kt, ui/Dock.kt, ui/FannyPack.kt, ui/PerformPanels.kt, ui/XyUi.kt, ui/NotesScreen.kt, assets/sounds/library.json.

_roles.ink: dark panels and the dark word colour (C.Ink)
_roles.card2: raised cards, used loops, inactive slider track (C.Card2)
_roles.empty: empty outlines, dashed rules, disabled words (C.Empty)
_roles.cream: the light word colour and sticker outline (C.Cream); on a light skin it is the dark one
_roles.pink: accent, sticker shadow, recording, beat on the one
_roles.yellow: on, current, headings, readouts in classic
_roles.riot: red: danger words, clicks counter, record onto pad
_roles.grit: strength of the grit over the page (1 = Classic; above 1 draws a second offset layer)
_roles.shadow: sticker shadow override; null keeps each sticker's own colour (pink by default)
_roles.pad: pad face: jar, glass, band or felt (see padFaces)
_roles.light: light skin: dark words, dark status bar icons

derivedColours.well: deepest panels (BPM box, fader wells, lane strips): black on dark skins, 0xFFCFC5AE on a light skin
derivedColours.letters: loop and throw colours in order A..H: [pink, teal, yellow, purple, sky, orange, lime, riot]
derivedColours.padColor: a jar colour on the machine: lerp(jarColour, ink, 0.22)
derivedColours.pcColor: Roll row colour by pitch class k (0..11): k<4 lerp(teal, pink, k/4); k<8 lerp(pink, yellow, (k-4)/4); else lerp(yellow, riot, (k-8)/4)
derivedColours.inkOn: words on a colour: whichever of ink and cream has the higher contrast ratio ((L1+.05)/(L2+.05), relative luminance)
derivedColours.mutedPad: black at alpha .6 over the pad, then an oxblood slash 5 dp from (12%, 88%) to (88%, 12%)
derivedColours.muteModeRim: oxblood stroke 4 dp round every loaded pad
derivedColours.pressedPad: fill lerp(base, cream, .55), pink ring 6 dp, scale .93

hardware._about: Hw: bakelite and worn metal for the panel Look. The same in every skin.

looks._about: UiLook: the button skin, separate from the colour skin. Default 'panel' for everyone (pref panelLook set once).
looks.proRailDots: dots r 1.2 dp every 6 dp, odd rows offset half a step
looks.panelRail: vertical gradient [PlateTop, Plate, 0xFF151311], faint brushed lines (white .015 to .045 every 2 to 5 px), up to 14 scratches (white .08), top edge white .12 1.5 px, bottom edge black .6 2 px, a screw r 3 dp 7 dp in from each end
looks.plate: panel: fill Plate, brass rule 1.5 dp top and/or bottom; classic: fill ink
looks.trayFrame: panel: sticker(Plate, shadow 5 dp black .6, border 2 dp Brass); classic: sticker(ink, shadow 5 dp, border 3 dp yellow)
looks.lcd: readout window: round rect r 5 dp, metal gradient bezel 2.5 dp [MetalLow, Metal, MetalHi], glass Glass (lit 0xFF1C2416) r 3 dp, amber scanlines alpha .035 every 3 px, top glint white .10
looks.masterPlate: gradient [0xFF2E2A26, 0xFF221F1C] r 8 dp, Brass .85 stroke 2.5 dp, inner black .5 stroke 1 dp inset 4 dp, four screws r 3.5 dp 9 dp in
looks.tabSlot: track 0xFF14110F r 7 dp, top shade black .55 to clear over 10 dp, bottom edge white .08 1.5 px; current tab is a bakelite key filled with tileFill.place, no lamp
looks.frameRule: top bar bottom rule: panel Brass 2 + 4*beat dp, lerp to cream (on the one) or yellow by the beat; classic pink 3 + 4*beat dp. Tabs top rule: Brass 2 dp (classic pink 3 dp). Bottom dock top rule: Brass 2 dp (classic teal 2 dp).

bakeliteKey._about: Modifier.bakelite in ui/Widgets.kt: the panel Look's key.
bakeliteKey.shadow: black .55 offset (0, 2.5 dp), gone while pressed; pressed key moves down 2 dp
bakeliteKey.capPlain: gradient [lerp(BakeTop, tint, .6), lerp(Bake, tint, .5), lerp(BakeLow, tint, .4)]; pressed [lerp(BakeLow, tint, .35), lerp(Bake, tint, .45)]; no tint: plain Bake colours
bakeliteKey.capFilled: a key with an icon: gradient [lerp(tile, white, .18), tile, lerp(tile, black, .32)]; pressed [lerp(tile, black, .35), lerp(tile, black, .2)]
bakeliteKey.scuffs: 3 pale lines white .05 to .10, 1 px, seeded by size so they never change
bakeliteKey.lamp: only on switches (on given): bead r 2.6 dp centred in the lip; glow radial lamp .6 to clear r 13 dp when on; ring black .5 r 3.51 dp; off colour 0xFF0E0B09; highlight white .55 on / .18 off r .91 dp
bakeliteKey.rim: metal; brass for Primary (Play, Rec); oxblood for Danger

tileFill._about: Nov 22: tile colours from Tyler's icon boards, by icon group, the same in every skin. A panel key with an icon is filled with its group's colour.
tileFill._capInk: words on a filled cap: 0xFF1A1613 when the tile's luminance > .45, else 0xFFF6EBD6
tileFill._tileColorProLooks: Pro dark and light use skin colours instead: transport yellow, place 0xFFA070E0, perform pink, sound teal, other 0xFF5C5668
tileFill._capTint: classic words-only keys that open a thing: Sample and Swap sound get 'sound'; place-group words get 'place'; Edit, Pack, Menu get 'perform'; FX, LFO, XY..., Keys get 'sound'; plain switches none

iconGroups._lookup: Icons.forLabel strips everything but letters and spaces, then matches exactly or ignoring case; Icons.named goes through _aliases first. 'tool', 'loop' and 'edit' have no tileFill entry, so they get 'other'.

lamps._about: lampFor(tag, onColor, danger) in ui/Widgets.kt: in the panel Look each lamp colour means one thing.
lamps.takesSoundAway: Hw.Oxblood: danger keys, onColor oxblood, mute-key, drop-key, synth-new-here when its onColor is riot
lamps.shape: teal (skin): onColor teal and tag starts with lfo-wave-, lfo-type-, pfilt-type, synthkind-, scratchkind-
lamps.readout: Hw.Amber: LCD text only, never a lamp
lamps.ownColour: an onColor that is not yellow, teal, pink, riot, cream or oxblood (a loop letter, a pad colour) is kept as is

padMarks.dot: r 3.5 dp with a black ring 1.5 dp, 11 dp apart, 8 dp in from the right edge, from 36% down

vialColours._out: bypassed vial liquid goes grey; its lamp is oxblood .8; an in lamp with nothing in it is 0xFF3A3530

jarColours._about: assets/sounds/library.json cabs; a pad uses padColor(jar colour).

padFaces.jar: shadow 4 dp offset (pink when picked, else black), gradient [lerp(fill, cream, .12), lerp(fill, ink, .18)], top highlight white .16 4 dp tall inset 5 dp
padFaces.glass: black .7 shadow at .6 offset, body lerp(fill, ink, .78), radial glow of fill (.7, .95 pressed) centred at 62% height r 62% of min side, white .08 shine on the top 34%
padFaces.band: body paper (fill .35 pressed), top 22% band of fill, edge fill .7 2 dp
padFaces.felt: black .22 shadow, flat fill, stitched inset white .35 1.5 dp dashed 6/5 px at 4 dp
padFaces.border: loaded pad 2 dp black, picked 3 dp cream
padFaces.empty: dashed empty outline 2 dp (12/8 px), slash empty 2 dp from (8%, 92%) to (92%, 8%), '+' 22 sp bottom right
padFaces.openPack: yellow bar 7 dp along the bottom, pink .55 6 dp below it
padFaces.packedShut: yellow .8 dashed zipper 3 dp (5/6 px) from 10 dp to 45% width, 5 dp up
padFaces.nameSize: room = padDp - 16; cap = clamp(room/6, 11.5, 15); size = max(7, min(cap, room*1.13/longestWordLength)) sp, Archivo Black, up to 3 lines

sizing.rdp: real dp = value / clamp(viewSize, .4, 2). View size choices .7 .8 .9 1 1.1 1.2 (stored clamp .6..1.3). The whole UI density is multiplied by viewSize.
sizing.barPlan: every key in the bottom dock gets one width: base = max(44 rdp, widest word measured in Block 9.5 sp * .86 + 10, panel ? 46 rdp * big : 38); gap 5; More key is base wide; readout keeps at least 56 rdp. Keys shrink to 38 rdp before any goes into More; no key is wider than 1.5 x base. Priorities (higher leaves first, 0 never): open-padmenu 0, repeat-toggle/fx-toggle 1, chords-toggle 2, hold-toggle 3, mute-key 4, drop-key 5, pack-toggle 6.

btnPanel.padV: small 5 | normal 7, plus lip at the bottom
btnPanel.iconBeside: small 28 | normal 32 rdp * big, 7 dp gap
btnPanel.iconStackedTight: 30 rdp * big, word 10 sp under it

btnClassic.shadow: Primary small 4 normal 5; Quiet 0; else small 3 normal 4
btnClassic.border: Primary small 3 normal 3.5; Quiet 1.5; else small 2.5 normal 3
btnClassic.pressedSink: into its shadow; on keys sit 1 dp in

pickSlider.height: with icons 30 rdp * big + 26, else 40 rdp * big; plus 6
pickSlider.notch: white .07 1 dp, 8 dp from the ends
pickSlider.word: 9.5 sp with icon, 12 sp without, * big

sizing.editTabKeys: height max(36, 40 / clamp(viewSize, .4, 2)) + lip, icon 30 * big, word 11 sp Worn
sizing.dockWord: full width, min 32 tall, 10 sp Mono

topBar.weightsOther: play 1.25, stop .55, rec 1.05, undo .55, tempo .8, loop .9, faq .55, menu .55

vial.name: Stencil; wide (> 560 widthDp) 10 sp, under a row 9.5 sp, else 7.5 sp, all * big; names of 4 letters or fewer +1.5 sp
vial.perRow: all 11 in one row, or 6 per row under a pad row on screens up to 560 widthDp

sizing.midiMapPanel: classic: top 56, start 22, end 12; other layouts: bottom 196, sides 12
sizing.loopStripMaxHeight: half the screen height (in app dp)

spacing.scrollPane: padding start 12, top 12, end 12 + 14 (clear of the scroll bar), bottom 12 + 24
spacing.card: padding 12, sticker shadow 6, outer room end 6 bottom 6
spacing.sticker: square by default (radius 0), border 3 cream, hard shadow 3 pink, offset down-right
spacing.sectionLabel: 11 or 12 sp, letter spacing .1 em, yellow or dim, uppercase

typography._about: res/font. Every one is OFL. Sizes in sp; all multiplied by Large keys (1.25) where noted * big.

Archivo.use: default text T (14 sp ExtraBold, line height 1.25x), classic Btn words (13/12 sp uppercase, spacing .08 em, Black for Primary), pad names (Black)

Bungee.use: headings and sheet titles (Heading: uppercase, 20 sp yellow, hard pink shadow offset 4, 4 px), GlitchTitle (teal at -2,0, pink at 2,2, yellow on top), big BPM (44 sp), Welcome numbers

Mono.use: Note lines (12 sp Normal, dim), classic readouts (BPM 12 sp, position 10 sp, Bold), step numbers, dock words, side words, MIDI marks

Worn.use: panel key words: 13 sp (small 12), tight 10 sp, spacing .03 em (tight 0), uppercase; PickSlider words in panel; edit drawer words 11 sp

Stencil.use: stamped words under panel keys and tabs when word plates are off (8 sp * big), vial name plates, MASTER · THROWS and MUD FILTER headings (13 sp, brass)

Lcd.use: panel readouts in amber: BPM 14 sp, loop position 12 sp, lag and clicks 9 sp, key readout 13 sp, key panel readout 14 sp, hold count 16 sp

Block.use: word plates under panel keys: 9.5 sp * big, uppercase, spacing -.02 em, squashed scaleX .86

typography.oneLineShrink: a one-line text that does not fit shrinks by 0.9 steps down to 62 percent before it ends in an ellipsis; drawn only once it fits; kept while the words change

texture.grit: 96 x 96 px tile, seeded Random(7): 6 percent of pixels alpha 26, next 6 percent alpha 14, colour (255, 244, 226); tiled over the page at alpha min(grit, 1); grit above 1 draws a second layer offset (48, 31) px at alpha grit - 1
texture.dashedRule: 2 dp line, dashes 10/7 px, colour empty

enamel._about: colour matrix on inlaid icons: saturation s = 1.1 lit, .78 unlit; luma weights .2126 .7152 .0722; offsets lit (+10, +6, 0), unlit (+6, 0, -12) on R, G, B (0..255 scale)
enamel.shadow: the same icon tinted black .7 (SrcIn) drawn 1 dp right, 1.5 dp down

motion.sheetIn: slide up 1/12 of its height plus fade, 150 ms; out fade 120 ms
motion.beatPulse: snap to 1 on each beat, fall to 0 over 60000 / bpm * .8 ms, LinearOutSlowIn

gestures.padSwipe: 44 dp within 300 ms; direction when the other axis is under half; the pad's hit is taken back at 24 dp (sound fades in 6 ms)
gestures.settingsFlickUp: same 44 dp / 300 ms upward; always on for DOCK_FLICK keys: pack-toggle, hold-toggle, chords-toggle, repeat-toggle, keysbar-open, dock-repeat, dock-mouth, dock-xy
gestures.tapOrHold: hold still 450 ms then lift for the menu; any move past touch slop cancels both
gestures.pressKeyQuick: under 300 ms counts as a tap (Mute stays on)
gestures.circle: finger path longer than 40 dp whose summed turning passes 5 radians (about 286 degrees)
gestures.emptyPadSplit: a touch is 'top' (record) when y < height * (.92 - x / width)
